    text = re.sub(r'-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8}\.(mjs|js|css)', '-H.\\1', text)
    text = re.sub(r'>', '>\n', text)
    return text.splitlines()
for f in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(base, '*'))):
    name = os.path.basename(f)
    if name == 'server.log': continue
    a = norm(open(f).read()); b = norm(open(os.path.join(after, name)).read())
    d = list(difflib.unified_diff(a, b, lineterm='', n=0))
    print(f'== {name}: {"SAME" if not d else str(len(d)) + " diff lines"}')
    for line in d[:12]: print('   ', line[:200])
EOF
